browserValidation.environment: Bundled Chromium revision 1217 through Playwright 1.61.1 on Windows against the local React Router production build at 127.0.0.1:3037. Desktop tests used 1280x900 in light mode and mobile tests used 390x844 in dark mode; the canonical sweep used 1365x900.
scenarios: Configured non-default values on all five share routes, created production-origin links through the visible Share setup controls, and opened each link in a new clean browser context.

Verified restored fields, accessible shared-setup confirmation, no automatic timer start, no automatic sound, clean canonical and Open Graph URLs, no parameterized structured-data URL, and no automatic preset creation.
Started Countdown Timer, Pomodoro Timer, and HIIT Timer manually after loading their shared setups and verified each exposed the active Pause control.
Tested desktop light mode at 1280x900 and mobile dark mode at 390x844 for all five share routes with no document-level horizontal overflow.

For Countdown Timer, Pomodoro Timer, HIIT Timer, and Time Zone Meeting Planner, saved a named preset, reloaded, loaded and verified it, renamed it, deleted it, saved two records, confirmed and completed Delete all, injected corrupt storage, and verified safe recovery.
Verified clearing one tool's presets preserved an unrelated localStorage key and preset actions did not add URL parameters.

Rendered all 132 canonical routes in Chromium with HTTP 200, one H1, canonical metadata, no document-level horizontal overflow, no hydration-failure text, and no browser console errors after waiting for network idle.
screenshots: Ten viewport captures cover each supported share route at 1280x900 light and 390x844 dark in the Codex visualizations workspace.
Manual review confirmed wrapped mobile action rows, stacked narrow inputs, readable dark surfaces, visible touch controls, and no Stage 6 control overlap.
limitations: The automated interaction pass used one Chromium-family browser on Windows and does not independently prove Safari, Firefox, physical-phone, or assistive-technology behavior.
Audio did not autostart because no timer entered a running state before explicit interaction; the test does not verify audible speaker output after a manual start.
Clipboard behavior was tested with browser permission granted; source and unit coverage verify the manual-copy fallback when clipboard access fails.
